label: modern_population_sensitivity
label_text: Policy experiment on the modern population: not a replay or a costing of Autumn Statement 2022.

diagnosis.evidence: pe-uk rates/dividends.yaml at 2.132.6 and 2.143.0; the artifacts' modern_processed readback (150,000 against 125,140)
diagnosis.fixed_in: policyengine-uk 2.139.4 (83de1ef1d, 'Correct historical dividend income tax band thresholds')
diagnosis.summary: pe-uk 2.132.6 keeps the dividend additional-rate threshold at £150,000 until April 2026, so restoring £150,000 leaves the dividend band unchanged in 2024-25 and 2025-26 and the effect is the main band's alone. The model swap measures the dividend leg (model_change on 2.143.0).
